title: The Own Goal — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The own goal is a very specific kind of mistake
The kind where you did everything right
And it still ended up wrong

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
オウンゴールを決めたディフェンダー [The defender who scored the own goal]
は危険を取り除こうとしていた [Was trying to clear the danger]
ボールはただ違うアイデアを持っていた [The ball simply had different ideas]
ボールは常に違うアイデアを持ってきた [The ball has always had different ideas]
ボールは意図に興味がない [The ball is not interested in intentions]

[Chorus — English]
The own goal says — I was trying to help
The own goal says — the ball went that way
The net says nothing — the net just holds it

[Bridge — 中文]
走回中线的路 [The walk back to the halfway line]
是体育运动中最漫长的路之一 [Is one of the longest walks in sport]
每一步都是 [Every step is the exact distance between]
你打算做的事情 [What you meant to do]
和实际发生的事情之间的距离 [And what actually happened]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas said — the own goal is the most honest moment in football
The player cannot blame anyone else
Not while the replay is still running

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The own goal
オウンゴール [The own goal]
乌龙球 [The own goal]
That's my boy
